Thank you.

failed_payout.escalation_note:
failure code: invalid_currency
A payout of 10.00 USD to Spike Seller (acct_example_001) failed. The payout is po_example_016. It went to external account ba_example_010 at STRIPE TEST BANK, ending 4440.

The bank was unable to process this payout because of its currency. This is probably because the bank account cannot accept payments in that currency.

Software cannot fix this. A person needs to review the payout and the bank account details.
